summary: The raw catalog is retained separately and reused during 304 revalidation, with a focused regression test covering a narrower enrichment value.

evidence: src/catalog/store.ts stores and validates the un-enriched source body separately from the served body.
src/catalog/index.ts revalidates using cached.source_body instead of the widened cached.body.
tests/openrouter-catalog.test.ts verifies the window widens to 1,050,000 and later decreases to the endpoint ceiling of 872,000.
